info.title: mdnet
info.description: Generates AI-friendly, signature-first API documentation (Markdown + static HTML via Markdoc) for .NET libraries from source or NuGet packages, and syncs published docs.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: mdnet: AI-friendly API documentation for .NET libraries (Markdown + Markdoc HTML).

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate docs from source code or from referenced NuGet packages.

options.name: --packages
options.description: Package mode: document NuGet packages referenced by the projects whose id matches (e.g. "Acme.*"). Repeatable.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory. Markdown goes to <output>/md, HTML to <output>/html. [default: docs]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output formats: md, html. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --visibility
options.description: Lowest accessibility to document. [default: Protected]

options.name: --include
options.description: Source mode: only projects whose name matches. Repeatable.

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Source mode: skip projects whose name matches. Test projects are always skipped. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --runtime
options.description: JavaScript runtime used to render HTML: auto, bun or node. [default: auto]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress. [default: False]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Only show warnings and errors. [default: False]

commands.name: render
commands.description: Render a Markdown docs folder into a static HTML site.

options.name: --output
options.description: HTML output directory.

options.name: --runtime
options.description: JavaScript runtime used to render HTML: auto, bun or node. [default: auto]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress. [default: False]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Only show warnings and errors. [default: False]

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: Markdown docs root (generated or downloaded), e.g. docs/md or .mdnet/docs.

commands.name: download
commands.description: Download published docs into a local docs root.

options.name: --ref
options.description: Git branch, tag or commit.

options.name: --path
options.description: Folder(s) inside the git repository holding package docs. Default: every docs folder in the repository.

options.name: --git
options.description: Treat the source as a git repository even if the URL does not look like one. [default: False]

options.name: --output
options.description: Docs root; each package goes to <output>/<id>. [default: .mdnet/docs]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress. [default: False]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Only show warnings and errors. [default: False]

arguments.name: SOURCE
arguments.description: HTTP(S) URL of a docs folder (containing mdnet.json), a git repository URL, or a local directory.

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Download published docs for referenced packages, as configured in mdnet.sources.json.

options.name: --config
options.description: Sources file. Default: mdnet.sources.json next to the solution/project or in the directory.

options.name: --prune
options.description: Delete downloaded docs of packages that are no longer referenced. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress. [default: False]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Only show warnings and errors. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Solution, project or directory whose package references are synced. [default: .]
